Job title:  Mobile Podiatrist 

  Job type:  Full time or part time 

  Salary offer:  $71k to $105k annually + super + CPD allowance + benefits 

  Location:  Brisbane 

   

  About the company:   

 Our client is a Podiatrist-owned organisation with a strong reputation for excellence in  Biomechanics, Sports, Exercise, and General Podiatry . Operating as part of a multidisciplinary network, they provide outstanding care across clinical and mobile settings. 

   

  About the role:   

 As a  Mobile Podiatrist , you’ll bring high-quality podiatry care directly to patients in their homes, aged care facilities, and community settings. You’ll manage a diverse caseload, supporting patients with musculoskeletal concerns, diabetes-related foot care, and general podiatry needs. In this role, you will: 

 
	 Deliver patient-centred assessments and treatments across a mobile service area 
	 Build strong relationships with patients and community healthcare partners 
	 Enjoy the independence of a mobile schedule with the backing of a supportive multidisciplinary team 
	 Have opportunities to focus on  Sports, Exercise & Biomechanical Podiatry  if desired 
 

 This role offers flexibility, autonomy, and variety — perfect for Podiatrists who enjoy being on the move while making a real impact in the community. 

   

  Benefits:   

 
	  Attractive remuneration  
	  Annual $2,000 CPD allowance , plus  bonus and commission  opportunities 
	  Company vehicle or travel allowance  provided for mobile visits 
	  Flexible full-time or part-time options  
	  Mentoring & support:  Weekly, fortnightly, or monthly sessions tailored to your experience 
	  Career pathways:  Leadership and clinical specialisation tracks available 
	  Employer-funded parental leave  
	  Professional development:  Monthly case studies, in-house CPD, and biannual workshops 
	  Wellbeing support:  Employee Assistance Program (EAP) 
	  Staff discounts  on the full suite of allied health services 
 

   

  Requirements:   

 
	 Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in Podiatry 
	 Current  AHPRA registration  (or eligibility to obtain) 
	 Valid  driver’s licence  and reliable vehicle (if not using a company car) 
	 Excellent communication and time-management skills 
	 Passion for delivering Podiatry care in the community and helping patients maintain mobility and independence 
 

   

  APPLY NOW  to join a supportive team that values your expertise and encourages your development every step of the way.   Apply Now

result.description:
Business Analyst – Preston VIC

Kogan People Solutions, recruiters, are working with a long-established and successful furniture retailer based in Preston, VIC. The company specialises in premium indoor and outdoor furniture, including sofas, dining furniture, bedroom suites, recliners, and home décor. With multiple retail showrooms, a growing eCommerce presence, and a commitment to exceptional customer experiences, our client is seeking an experienced and qualified Business Analyst to support the continued growth and business transformation.

About the Role:

The new Business Analyst will work across retail, eCommerce, supply chain and operational functions. The successful candidate will work closely with stakeholders to analyse business processes, identify opportunities for improvement, and deliver technology and operational initiatives that enhance efficiency, customer experience and business performance.

•	Tenure – The role is full time and ongoing.

•	Location – Preston VIC

•	Salary – Salary, negotiable in the range of $80k to $90k plus superannuation per annum.

Responsibilities will include:

•	Engage with stakeholders across the business to gather, document and analyse business requirements.

•	Review existing business processes and identify opportunities for operational improvement and automation.

•	Analyse sales, inventory, customer and operational data to support strategic decision-making.

•	Develop business cases, functional specifications, process maps and workflow documentation.

•	Liaise with software vendors, developers and internal stakeholders during system implementation and enhancement projects.

•	Support the implementation of ERP, CRM, eCommerce and other business systems.

•	Conduct user acceptance testing (UAT) and coordinate system testing activities.

•	Prepare reports, dashboards and performance metrics to support business objectives.

•	Assist with change management, user training and post-implementation reviews.

•	Ensure solutions align with business objectives and industry best practice.

To be successful in this role you will have:

•	A bachelor's degree or higher qualification in Business, Information Technology, Business Information Systems or a closely related discipline.
•	At least one years of relevant experience as a Business Analyst in a similar setting.

•	Strong analytical, problem-solving and stakeholder management skills.

•	Proficiency with specific software tools (e.g., ERP systems, WMS, TMS), data analysis tools like Excel, SQL, or BI platforms.

•	Experience documenting business requirements, process mapping and business process improvement.

•	Experience working with ERP, CRM, retail or eCommerce systems will be highly regarded.

•	Advanced communication and documentation skills.

•	A results-driven mindset with a focus on improving company outcomes while achieving personal and team objectives.

•	Ability to multitask and prioritise in a fast-paced environment.

•	Solid references.

You must have unrestricted full time Australian working rights to be considered.

Applications

Please respond to the recruiters using the facilities on this site, and ensure you attach your updated CV.

Kogan People Solutions are grateful for all applications, but kindly note that they will only respond to shortlisted applicants.

Kogan People Solutions – recruitment excellence

Position: Civil Engineer 
Type: Full-time 
Employer: KFM Geotech Pty Ltd 
Location: Castle Hill NSW 2154 
Salary: $80,080 p/a
About the Business: 
KFM Geotech Pty Ltd is a reputable geotechnical, environmental, and groundwater engineering consulting firm based in Castle Hill, NSW. Founded by Dr. Mohammad Hossein Bazyar, we deliver comprehensive site investigations, construction phase support, pavement design, foundation engineering, contamination assessments, and hydrogeological services to builders, developers, architects, engineers, and government clients across New South Wales. Committed to excellence, innovation, integrity, and sustainability, we prioritise high-quality, timely, and budget-conscious solutions that ensure safe, compliant, and successful development projects while fostering a collaborative and supportive workplace culture.
About the Position: 
The Civil Engineer plays a pivotal role in delivering expert geotechnical and civil engineering solutions that underpin safe and efficient construction projects at KFM Geotech Pty Ltd. This position involves conducting site investigations, providing construction-phase support, designing foundations and pavements, assessing environmental and groundwater conditions, and ensuring all deliverables meet regulatory standards and client requirements in a dynamic consulting environment.
Key Responsibilities:
•	Conduct geotechnical site investigations, soil/rock testing, and analysis to inform foundation, retaining wall, and pavement designs.
•	Provide construction-phase geotechnical support, including excavation monitoring, bearing capacity assessments, and on-site inspections.
•	Prepare detailed technical reports, drawings, and recommendations for clients, councils, and stakeholders.
•	Perform environmental and groundwater assessments, including contamination and hydrogeological evaluations.
•	Collaborate with project teams, clients, and regulatory bodies to ensure compliance with Australian standards and project timelines.
•	Contribute to project management, risk assessments, and continuous improvement of geotechnical practices.
Requirements:
•	Australian citizens and permanent residents are encouraged to apply.
•	Minimum Bachelor Degree in Civil Engineering (or equivalent).
•	Minimum 2-3 years of experience as a civil engineer, preferably in geotechnical consulting or construction.
•	Strong technical skills in geotechnical analysis, foundation design, site investigation, and report writing.
•	Proficiency with relevant software (e.g., geotechnical modelling tools) and excellent problem-solving abilities.
